story: My younger brother is 14. He works at a car wash in Surat and they have not paid him Rs 4,000 for October 2026.

timeline.event: User reports that their younger brother has not been paid Rs 4,000 for October 2026 for working at a car wash.
timeline.user_words: My younger brother is 14. He works at a car wash in Surat and they have not paid him Rs 4,000 for October 2026.

red_flags: Minor (14-year-old) employed at a car wash
missing: Name of the car wash owner or management
Exact dates of work performed in October 2026
Whether the brother is still employed there
Whether any legal notice or communication has been sent

messages: Because you (or the person) may be under 18, please call the Child Helpline on 1098. They can help get unpaid wages and keep the child safe. Employing a child is itself illegal, so this needs a person, not an app.
अगर उम्र 18 साल से कम है, तो 1098 (चाइल्ड हेल्पलाइन) पर कॉल करें। वे बकाया पैसे और बच्चे की सुरक्षा - दोनों में मदद करेंगे।
